resolution.note: Replay transport at the stdio pipe: scripts/codex/app-server-replay.ts stands in as KRN_CODEX_BIN (record tees the real app-server, replay plays a transcript and fails at the first divergent frame), so the CLI, driver, CodexAppServer, process identity and reap stay real and production code gains no test seam. Three transcripts recorded from codex-cli 0.167.0 by KRN_LIVE=1 node scripts/live-worker.mjs --record (compact, failed-turn, interrupt) replay in test/worker/codex-replay.test.ts in about 1.5 s each.
